findings_summary: Fix #1 (context-capture): Added _capture_context_pct_at_spawn() reading from compact-risk.json (canonical) → context-phase.json → ctx-prev.json (fallback chain). Wired into 7x_faerie_spawn.py existing spawn-log COC entry as main_context_pct_at_spawn field. Verified locally: returns 0.0 from ctx-prev.json (current state).

Fix #1 (session log): Added _append_session_context_log() that writes per-session jsonl to ~/.claude/memory/forensics/session-{sid8}.jsonl with schema {ts,event,wave,wave_id,context_pct,task_id,agent_type,session_id}. Lets altimeter calibration jobs correlate context_pct with wave dispatch without scanning all spawn logs. Verified write works in tmp dir.

Fix #2 (manifest schema): Added 3 fields to the MANIFEST RETURN FORMAT prompt block in 0x_spawn_template.py — task_id (was implicit), wave_id (W1|W2|W3, required), main_context_pct_at_spawn (mirror of spawn-log capture). Agents now write wave_id alongside task_id, closing the agents_per_wave_W1 measurement gap.

EQUILIBRIUM RESPECT: Did NOT add new hook or new script. Wired into the existing spawn-log writer (7x_faerie_spawn.py:90-105) and existing prompt schema block (0x_spawn_template.py:1303). One function added (_capture_context_pct_at_spawn), one helper added (_append_session_context_log), zero new abstractions. Both are fail-open — measurement never breaks spawning.

BLOCKER: Edit to .claude/scripts/* was denied by sandbox (correct policy per CLAUDE.md FILE WRITING PROTOCOL). Patch artifact written to forensics/2026-04-28/artifacts/ for parent to apply via 5x_write_relay.py or git apply. Mission constraint: I cannot directly mutate .claude/, so manifest carries patch reference per fallback protocol.
